gaps.title: Processed chicken moves across three states into retail, no named monitoring system
gaps.detail: Venky's produces and sells processed chicken products from poultry operations spanning Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and southern India, distributed in part through its own Xprs retail outlets. For a fresh/frozen protein business operating at this multi-state scale, nothing in available research names a system tracking temperature consistency from processing plant to retail counter.
gaps.based_on: Venkateshwara Hatcheries' poultry operations are based across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and the southern states of India, and the company sells processed chicken through its own retail brand, Venky's Xprs; the Poultry and Poultry Products segment produces and sells... processed chicken products.

pitch.angle: Venky's is Asia's largest fully integrated poultry group, moving processed chicken from production facilities across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and southern India into its own Xprs retail network -- but nothing in its public materials names a monitoring system tracking that journey. For a fresh/frozen protein business operating at this scale and multi-state spread, GND's ThinxFresh would give one consistent, auditable view from processing plant to retail counter instead of assuming everything held cold in between.
pitch.opener: With processed chicken moving from your Maharashtra, MP, and southern India facilities into your own Xprs outlets, what's tracking temperature consistency across that whole journey today?
